data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 温泉旅馆的吃醋撒娇
data.description: 温泉旅馆和风榻榻米上，喝了点甜酒的雪菜双颊染满绯红。纯白细吊带睡裙微微松散，她气鼓鼓地鼓着脸颊坐在被褥前，水润眼眸中含着委屈又娇蛮的醋意，轻轻扯着身旁前辈的衣角不依不饶。
data.location: 和风温泉旅馆榻榻米障子房
data.action: 跪坐榻榻米气鼓鼓嘟嘴撒娇，单手微扯衣角含泪轻嗔
data.lighting: 和纸灯笼透出的暖金色温润光晕与榻榻米倒影
data.camera: 半身中近景，焦点落在娇嗔绯红的面庞与微嘟红唇
data.promptProse: Sitting on a comfortable futon in a traditional Japanese ryokan, Yukina pouts adorably with a flushed tipsy blush across her cheeks. Dressed in a delicate white cotton camisole with thin straps, her glossy amber-brown eyes glisten with playful jealous tears. Warm ambient light from paper lanterns illuminates her charming pouting expression as she leans forward.
data.animaCaption: Sitting on the tatami futon with an adorable tipsy pout and flushed cheeks, bathed in warm lantern glow.
